questions.question: What is the supplier delivery policy?
questions.note: Answerable and spans two chunks. A developer who passes only the top chunk gives an incomplete answer.

questions.question: What is the CEO salary?
questions.note: Absent from the corpus and topically far from everything. Must return no answer and no citations.

questions.question: How much notice is needed to avoid a contract renewal?
questions.note: Single-chunk answer. Confirms retrieval does not always return the delivery chunks. Answer is 60 days; DOC-001 states 90 days but is superseded.

questions.question: What is the late payment interest rate?
questions.note: The hard refusal. C004 retrieves strongly because it discusses payment and late payment, but states no rate. Catches a model that fills the gap.

embedding_sentences.text: The supplier reported a vehicle engine problem.
The vendor has an issue with the car motor.
The contract renewal date is next month.

planted_for_later_days.multi_chunk_fact: Delivery policy spans C001 and C002.
planted_for_later_days.near_miss_gap: Late payment interest rate is discussed but never quantified (DOC-003 section 5).
planted_for_later_days.conflict_and_staleness: DOC-001 v2.0 states a 90-day non-renewal notice; DOC-002 v1.4 states 60 days and supersedes it.
planted_for_later_days.restricted_content: Named contacts, rate card contents, bank verification and sourcing scores are marked restricted in the documents.
